name: ZIP
description: Create and open ZIP archives in your browser.

zip-create.name: Create ZIP
zip-create.description: Bundle any files into a ZIP archive — entirely on your device.

zip-extract.name: Extract ZIP
zip-extract.description: Open a ZIP, browse what's inside, and save the files you need — on your device.
